question: Which text is declared renowned throughout the three worlds?
premises: Text is renowned in three worlds.
inference: The colophon identifies Śāradāpaṭala as the renowned text.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical case of trailokyaprathite is inferred from context.
plain_english: In the Śāradāpaṭala, the text renowned in the three worlds, O Śiva.
